sections.title: Machinery access
paragraphs: Immediate access to the server-gated functional Create machinery and Sable contraptions. Normal recipes, progression, claim protection and the banned-item rules still apply; this does not grant creative mode or unrestricted administration.

sections.title: Items included
paragraphs: 1 Creative Blaze Cake for a compatible Create Blaze Burner.

1 Experience Disperser from Relics, delivered fully maxed. When equipped, its dispersion ability shares relic experience across your equipped relics; its rank bonuses also interact with player experience. Normal Relics equipment and ability rules still apply.

sections.title: Extra building allowances
paragraphs: +2 home slots, +1 player-owned public warp, +32 claim chunks and +1 force-loadable chunk, added to your natural allowances.
A claim chunk is a 16-by-16 block column protected through FTB Chunks. Force-loading is a separate allowance for selected claimed chunks and remains subject to server chunk-loading rules.

sections.title: Using the rewards
paragraphs: Use /rewards to claim the one-time item rewards after delivery. Make room in your inventory before claiming.
Set personal destinations with /sethome <name> and return with /home <name>. Use /pwarp to browse public destinations or /pwarp create <name> to create one on safe ground in your team's claim.
The Discord supporter role is handled by staff after linking your identity. Contact staff privately with your Minecraft name and receipt; do not share payment details in public.

commands.description: Open a portable crafting table; normal crafting ingredients are still required.
Open a portable stonecutter; normal material costs still apply.
Change your in-game nickname within the server's naming rules; your underlying Minecraft account identity is unchanged.
Rename the item held in your main hand. Supports & color codes; text is limited to 48 characters.
Open a disposal interface to discard unwanted items. Only place items in it that you intend to throw away.

supporterPackages.description: One-time purchase with no subscription or scheduled rank expiry. Higher tiers include the lower-tier features. All supporter rewards can also be earned through gameplay without paying.
features: Everything in Ember
AE2 Infinity Range Card and wireless crafting terminal with network hardware
/echest, /ascend, /anvil, /smithing and /grindstone
Custom public-warp icon with /pwarp icon <name> <item>, priority login and /rtp nether

sections.title: Includes Ember
paragraphs: All Ember command access, machinery access and its one-time item rewards are included if they have not already been delivered.

sections.title: Wireless AE2 bundle
paragraphs: 1 AE2 Infinity Range Card, 1 Wireless Crafting Terminal, 1 Wireless Access Point, 8 Wireless Boosters and 1 Charger.

The terminal lets you access a linked, powered ME network wirelessly. Configure and power the network and link the terminal as required by AE2. The Infinity Range Card expands supported wireless range; cross-dimension access is the separate Mythic Dimension Card benefit. This bundle does not include a complete ME storage network or stored resources.

sections.title: Extra building allowances
paragraphs: +3 home slots, +2 player-owned public warps, +64 claim chunks and +2 force-loadable chunks in total for the Artisan tier, added to your natural allowances. These replace Ember's smaller purchased bonuses rather than stacking a second set of bonuses.

sections.title: Travel and priority login
paragraphs: /rtp nether selects a random permitted Nether destination. It shares the 10-minute RTP cooldown and the five-second movement/damage-sensitive warmup. It does not bypass world borders, claims or other destination rules.

Priority login allows eligible players to use up to two reserved places beyond the normal player cap. It does not evict another player, bypass whitelist/bans, or guarantee access while the server is offline or all reserved places are occupied.
Use /pwarp icon <name> <item_id> to change the display icon of a public warp you own, for example /pwarp icon workshop minecraft:anvil.

commands.description: Open your own Ender Chest remotely; this does not open other players' inventories.
Look for a safe standing space above you in the same dimension and queue a teleport. It fails if no valid space is found.
Open a portable anvil; vanilla material and experience requirements still apply.
Open a portable smithing table; templates, equipment and materials are still required.
Open a portable grindstone, including its normal repair/disenchant behavior.
Request a random Nether destination under the travel rules above.
Set the menu icon for a public warp you own.

+4 homes, +3 public warps, +128 claim chunks and +4 force-loadable chunks

sections.title: Includes Artisan and Ember
paragraphs: All lower-tier command access, machinery access and one-time item bundles are included if they have not already been delivered.

sections.title: Relic choice
paragraphs: 1 voucher for a fully maxed Relics item from the server-approved selection. Claim the voucher through /rewards, hold it in your main hand and open /relic to choose your item. Then claim the selected relic through /rewards. Banned items are excluded. The choice is a one-time reward, not an unlimited relic generator.

sections.title: Extra building allowances
paragraphs: +4 home slots, +3 player-owned public warps, +128 claim chunks and +4 force-loadable chunks in total for the Runeforged tier, added to your natural allowances.

sections.title: Travel and flight limits
paragraphs: /rtp end adds random teleporting in the End. Your personal End-eye progression is still required: you must have discovered the required 12 distinct eyes. Buying a rank does not bypass that progression.

/waypoint <x> <y> <z> and supported JourneyMap waypoint teleporting move you to an allowed location in your current dimension. Teleporting requires five seconds without moving or taking damage. The normal destination, claim and border rules still apply.

/fly toggles creative flight anywhere in the world. You can fly in unclaimed areas and across claim boundaries; a claim is not required. Entering combat disables flight, and flight does not bypass block protection or other server rules.

commands.description: Refill your hunger and saturation. Five-minute cooldown; unavailable during combat.

Toggle creative flight on or off anywhere, without needing a claim. Double-tap jump to start or stop flying while enabled. Combat disables flight. This grants flight, not Creative mode or unlimited items.
Queue a teleport to permitted coordinates in your current dimension. Five-second warmup; two-minute cooldown. Stay still and avoid damage during the warmup.

Repair the damageable item in your main hand while preserving its other components. Costs one XP level per 100 durability repaired, rounded up, with a minimum of one level. Example: 250 damage costs three XP levels.
Request a random End destination after meeting personal End-eye requirements.

supporterPackages.description: One-time purchase with no subscription or scheduled rank expiry. Higher tiers include the lower-tier features. All supporter rewards can also be earned through gameplay without paying.
features: Everything in Runeforged, Artisan and Ember
1 empty infinite item storage cell and 1 AE2 Dimension Card
/heal, limited /effects, /prefix, /lore <text> and /joinmessage <text>
/worldtime <0-23999> and /worldweather <clear|rain|thunder> affect everyone in your current world; each has a 30-minute cooldown
/effects <speed|haste|night_vision|water_breathing> grants level-I effects for five minutes with a 15-minute cooldown; /prefix <text> changes your chat prefix
+5 homes, +5 public warps, +256 claim chunks and +6 force-loadable chunks

sections.title: Includes every lower rank
paragraphs: All Runeforged, Artisan and Ember command access and one-time item bundles are included if they have not already been delivered.

sections.title: AE2 storage and dimension items
paragraphs: 1 Infinite Item Storage Cell, delivered empty, plus 1 AE2 Dimension Card.
The storage cell is an item-storage component for a compatible AE2 network; it does not generate items or arrive filled with resources. Install it in compatible network hardware.

The Dimension Card adds the supported cross-dimension wireless capability to your configured AE2 wireless setup. A powered network, linked terminal and compatible hardware are still required. The card itself does not provide chunk loading.

sections.title: Extra building allowances
paragraphs: +5 home slots, +5 player-owned public warps, +256 claim chunks and +6 force-loadable chunks in total for the Mythic tier, added to your natural allowances.

sections.title: World-wide controls and cosmetics
paragraphs: World time and weather commands affect everyone in your current dimension, not just your own display. Each has its own 30-minute cooldown. Use them considerately and follow staff instructions.
Cosmetic text limits apply: /prefix supports up to 20 characters, /lore up to 100, and /joinmessage up to 80. Cosmetic permissions do not grant moderation powers.

commands.description: Restore your health and extinguish fire. Ten-minute cooldown; unavailable during combat or a boss encounter. This does not clear every status effect.
Choose speed, haste, night_vision or water_breathing. Gives the chosen level-I effect for five minutes; all choices share a 15-minute cooldown and cannot be used during combat.
Set your cosmetic chat prefix, subject to staff rank display and naming rules.
Choose a supported chat text color.
Replace the lore of the item in your main hand with your cosmetic text. Does not change the item's actual abilities.
Set your custom join message within the server's chat rules.
Change time in your current dimension. Examples: /worldtime 1000 for daytime or /worldtime 13000 for night. Thirty-minute cooldown.
Change weather in your current dimension. Example: /worldweather clear. Separate 30-minute cooldown; dimensions without normal weather may not show a weather change.

rules.title: Respect other players
rules.text: Treat other players respectfully. Harassment, threats, hate speech, discrimination, impersonation, and sharing private personal information are not allowed.

rules.title: No griefing or theft
rules.text: Do not damage, steal from, trap, or interfere with another player’s builds, items, creatures, or machines without permission. This applies to unclaimed builds as well as claims. Do not use explosions, fluids, mobs, or machinery to bypass protection.

rules.title: No cheating or exploit abuse
rules.text: Do not use unauthorized cheats, duplication bugs, or exploits that bypass progression or permissions. Intended abilities and items included in Mythforge are allowed unless staff has restricted them. Report bugs privately and do not distribute exploited items.

rules.title: PvP requires consent
rules.text: PvP is off by default. Use /pvp true to opt in or /pvp false to turn it off; both players must opt in for direct player damage. Consent to one fight is not permission for repeated attacks, spawn camping, trapping, or taking belongings. Indirect damage and traps do not bypass the consent rule.

rules.title: Claims and abandoned bases
rules.text: Claim the land you use and be careful when granting access. Do not surround another claim, block its access, or claim land solely to prevent someone’s expansion. Staff handles abandoned bases and claim disputes; an empty base is not permission to loot or demolish it.

rules.title: Automation and server performance
rules.text: Do not intentionally cause lag or crashes. Keep farms, entities, machines, and chunk loading reasonable. Staff may pause or adjust systems causing measurable performance problems. Do not bypass imposed limits or re-create a disabled setup.

rules.title: Playtime and AFK systems
rules.text: Playtime progresses while you are connected. Standing still to chat does not pause rewards. The server kicks idle players after 15 minutes, subject to staff exemptions. Do not use macros, movement loops or other tricks to evade the AFK kick or inflate rewards.

rules.title: Chat and community conduct
rules.text: Avoid spam, repeated unwanted messages or teleport requests, unsolicited advertising, explicit sexual content, and scams. Keep usernames, skins, build names, and public messages appropriate for a shared community.

rules.title: Staff decisions and appeals
rules.text: Follow staff instructions during an incident. Moderation may include warnings, mutes, temporary restrictions, or bans depending on severity. Do not evade sanctions with another account. Contact staff privately through Discord to appeal and provide relevant evidence.

Computers and automation join the pack, plus a round of mod updates.

player.

policies.privacy:
Effective October 26, 2026

Who operates this service
Mythforge is operated under the name Procyonine. For privacy questions or requests, email admin@mythforge.win or contact staff privately through the official Discord on the Contact page. Do not post sensitive information in public chat.

Website visits
This website has no visitor account system or payment form. Cloudflare hosts and protects the website and may process IP addresses, request timestamps, browser information and security logs. Cloudflare may also inject a performance analytics script to collect page-loading and browser performance measurements. The site does not set advertising cookies in its own code; Cloudflare and external providers have their own data-handling practices.

Server status
The Server page requests status from mcstatus.io. When your browser makes this request, that provider receives your IP address and normal request information, plus the public server hostname. It queries Minecraft’s public status response. The site displays availability and player totals, not a list of player names. Status results can be cached and may lag behind the server. mcstatus.io has its own service practices.

Minecraft server and support
Operating a multiplayer server involves Minecraft usernames and UUIDs, connection addresses, gameplay and chat logs, world and claim data, and moderation records. Information you send to staff may include Discord identifiers, messages, screenshots, and technical logs. This information is used to operate the world, investigate problems, enforce rules, and respond to support requests. In-game chat may be visible to other players; information submitted to public Discord channels is visible to their audiences.

Providers and sharing
Cloudflare, Discord, Minecraft account services, and CurseForge process information under their own policies when you use their services. Server administrators and relevant hosting providers may have access to operational data. Tebex handles payments under the terms and privacy information shown at checkout. Mythforge receives the Minecraft account and transaction references needed for delivery and support. This static website does not collect card numbers. Information may also need to be disclosed when required by law or to address a security incident.

Storage and privacy requests
Logs, world saves, backups, and support records may persist after a session ends. Contact staff to request access, correction, or deletion of information relating to you. We may need to verify account ownership and may need to keep records for security, moderation, backups, or legal obligations. Removing a record from active systems may not immediately remove it from backups. Applicable privacy rights depend on your location and the circumstances.

Children and sensitive information
Do not send identity documents, payment credentials, or other unnecessary sensitive information to staff. Discord users must meet Discord’s applicable age requirements. A parent or guardian may contact us about information relating to a child. Child-specific data collection or services require a separate review before introduction.

Public credits and privacy requests
The Beta Testers & Thanks page publishes the credited players’ Minecraft names and current head images using public UUIDs. A credited player can contact staff privately to ask for correction or removal from the page. Gameplay and moderation records are handled separately from public credits. Depending on applicable law, you may also request a copy of your information or object to or ask us to restrict particular processing. Explain the request through the Contact page; staff may need to confirm account ownership. If we cannot fulfill all of a request, we will explain the applicable reason and any records that must be retained. You may contact your local privacy regulator where you have that right.

Retention and access
Records are kept for service operation, support, security, moderation, backups, and legal obligations as described above. Different records may have different retention needs; this policy does not promise a fixed deletion period that has not been implemented. Operational information is intended for staff and providers who need it for those purposes. Ask staff about the records relating to your account.

International services
Third-party providers may process requests and records in countries different from yours. Their privacy policies explain their own processing and safeguards. Public website credits can be viewed worldwide.

Updates
This policy will be updated if the site adds accounts, analytics, payments, or other material changes in data handling. A new effective date will identify the revised version.

Whitelist applications
The application form sends your Minecraft Java username to our private Cloudflare-backed application service. It uses Cloudflare Turnstile to limit automated submissions and processes Minecraft identity/profile information and local server-ban checks to assess the application. Staff receive private review notifications. Do not enter passwords, payment details or a Microsoft email address in the username field. Contact staff for privacy or application-review requests.
